name: Male 02 (deep calm)
sounds_like: The lowest voice in the library: median pitch 82 Hz, bottoming out near 55 Hz. Also the darkest (centroid 948 Hz, 85% of energy under 2056 Hz) - chest, not head. Very clean, no breath or buzz (flatness 0.0003). Narrow 8.7-semitone move, settling downward at phrase ends. Leaves real air: 22% silence, pauses to 0.59s. Source line is grounding advice - draw, paint, make music - delivered evenly and unhurried.
casts_well_as: Calm authority, mentor, therapist, elder, judge, deep narration and cold-open voiceover. The genuine low-register narrator of this library.
avoid_for: Youth, excitement, comedy, panic, or anything shouted. It has no top end to open up into.
note: If you want a deep narrator, this is it - not chadwick, which scripts/make_audio_library.py labels narrator_deep despite measuring 167 Hz. Mapped to calm_measured and char_griffith in that same script.
